name: flow_queue_find_players_pill_and_cancel
description: A party of one on a server (design 5.2): with open seats off the button is Play; the leader turns open seats on (the empty rows read '+ open seat') and it becomes Find players; pressing it sends QUEUE enter and reads 'Entering queue...' until QUEUE_STATE says queued; then the pill counts 'Finding players 0:02' from the server's elapsed_ms and the button reads 'Cancel · 0:02'; Esc (or the button) sends QUEUE leave, 'Leaving queue...', and the server's idle brings the hub back, pill gone, open seats still on.

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Play' and node('OpenSeats').visible and node('OpenSeats').text == 'open seats: off'
steps.msg: open seats off: Play, an offline match at once; the leader may open the seats

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', '+ invite', '+ invite', '+ invite']
node('OpenSeats').text == 'open seats: on' and node('HubPanel').lines() == ['diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', '+ open seat', '+ open seat', '+ open seat']
steps.msg: open seats on: the empty rows are open seats
a party of one with open seats: Find players
the request on its way: Entering queue..., disabled
one QUEUE enter on its way
the pill counts from the server's elapsed_ms

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Cancel · 0:02' and not node('Primary').disabled and node('HubPanel').second_text() == ''
steps.msg: the leader's button cancels; no caretakers yet
the line says what the queue does
Esc leaves the queue: Leaving queue...
QUEUE leave: the party forming again

steps.assert: node('Shell').pill_text() == '' and node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Find players' and Session.open_seats()
steps.msg: the pill gone, open seats still on
